Root cause: The evidence does not establish a failing mechanism. Nearly every dispatch returned an empty answer: no nginx logs [tr_38611975bcd5], no compose-post logs [tr_f5e3ed08eb82], no nginx traces across a full hour [tr_ebf55ae35440], and no span-metric samples at all for compose-post, home-timeline or user-timeline in either the incident or baseline window [tr_0d99b3b3f553, tr_6a0a1142c89c, tr_73654c07a93e]. The only non-empty signals are nginx's intermittent, non-sustained error ratio with no baseline to compare against [tr_0b7d99223f50] and change records showing that nginx-web-server and compose-post-service were both first created by platform-automation about three minutes before onset [tr_08bfa0bd702e, tr_88ef5ea29f07]. The most defensible reading is that this environment was being brought up from scratch at 16:03 and alerted at 16:06 before the stack had stabilised or begun emitting telemetry; the specialists found no running-state fault to attribute. Naming a culprit service and mechanism on this board would be invention.
Faulty component: nginx-web-server
Fault type: unknown
Confidence: low
